maintenance.title: The Platform Is Temporarily Unavailable
maintenance.message:
We apologize for the inconvenience. The platform is currently unavailable due to scheduled maintenance and updates being carried out to improve performance and enhance your overall experience.

We appreciate your understanding, and access to the platform will be restored as soon as the maintenance work is completed.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
maintenance.support: If you need further information or experience any issue related to accessing the platform, please feel free to contact Technical Support for assistance.

supportBot.title: E.Camp Support
supportBot.subtitle: Answers questions about using the platform
supportBot.greeting:
Hi! I can help with using E.Camp: activation codes, signing in, videos and your account.
I can't answer lesson or science questions.
supportBot.privacy: Never share passwords or activation codes in this chat.
supportBot.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
supportBot.tooMany: You've sent a lot of messages. Please wait a minute and try again.

supportAdmin.title: Support assistant
supportAdmin.subtitle: The chat assistant students see on every page. It only replies with the answers you write here, or says it can't help.
supportAdmin.safety: Locked down by design: the assistant never writes its own answers, cannot see any accounts, codes or admin data, and refuses requests about codes, passwords, admin access, hacking, lesson content or general questions. The AI only decides which of your questions matches.
supportAdmin.editorHint: Write the question and answer in Arabic, English or both. Students see the answer in their language.
supportAdmin.emptyDesc: Add your own, or start with the ready-made common questions (codes, sign-in, videos) and edit them.
supportAdmin.deleteMsg: Delete "{{q}}"? The assistant will stop using this answer.
supportAdmin.unansweredHint: Questions the assistant couldn't match. Write an answer to teach it, or dismiss.
supportAdmin.allAnswered: Nothing waiting. The assistant answered everything it was asked.
supportAdmin.testHint: Type a question the way a student would. You'll see exactly what they would get. Nothing is saved.

watermark.hint: Every video shows a small 8-character code that belongs to the student watching. Type the code from a leaked screenshot or recording to see whose account it came from.
watermark.label: Watermark code
watermark.faintTip: Code cropped out? The whole video also carries a very faint repeated copy of the code with the date and time. Open a screenshot in any photo editor and push the contrast (or levels) up hard to read it.
watermark.noneDesc: Check the letters and numbers again: 0–9 and A–F only.
